value.description: One of the family members urging the others to pause and reflect on their mother's intentions for the house.
evidence: Asha: Let's take a moment to breathe and gather ourselves; perhaps this interruption is an opportunity for us to gain further insight into what your mother truly envisioned for this home.

value.description: A family member who pushes for immediate action and wants to decide what to do with the house without further reminiscing.
evidence: Daniel: "Insight? We need action, not more stories; every second we waste is another dollar lost—let's just get to the point."
Daniel: "Well, Miguel, your timing couldn't be worse—this isn't exactly a social visit; we're trying to figure out what to do with the house, not reminisce about the past."

value.description: A family member who argues that reflecting on their mother's dreams will help them honor her wishes and decide their future.
evidence: Lucia: "Daniel, please—maybe this is exactly what we need; a moment to reflect on Mom's dreams could guide us in honoring her wishes while making the right choice for our future."
Lucia: "Yes, Miguel, she poured her heart into this home; it was a sanctuary for all of us. I believe she wanted it to remain a place of love and connection, not just another asset to sell."

value.description: A family member who opens the door for Miguel and supports the idea that memories can reveal what their mother would want.
evidence: Rosa: "Lucia's right, Daniel; sometimes it's in the stories and memories that we find the clarity we need—let's see what our mother's spirit has to say through those who knew her best."
Rosa stands up and opens the door to reveal Miguel, an old family friend.

value.description: An old family friend who arrives unexpectedly and recalls memories of the house and the family's mother.
evidence: Rosa stands up and opens the door to reveal Miguel, an old family friend.
Miguel: Hello, everyone! I hope I'm not interrupting anything too serious.
Miguel: Ah, the house... so many memories. I remember the laughter and gatherings we had here. Your mother loved this place.
